apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixed: when the phone was in your pocket and audio dropped out, pausing could yank the session (and the watch) back many minutes. It now catches up to where you really are first.

Sessions started from the watch now show up on the watch.
Tapping Start again on the watch mid-session no longer restarts the session on the phone.
The whole watch screen glows warm amber as you push.
The whole watch screen now glows warm amber as you push: it builds on the press, holds steady on the hold, and fades as you let go.
